correctness.rationale: Smooth genus-three plane quartics with one rational point at infinity; Kummer automorphism C6 ensures six distinct forms. All 18 curve/extension counts have been checked exhaustively in F13, F169 and F2197 using explicitly irreducible moduli and residue tests. Newton identities plus the Weil functional equation uniquely force the reported complete degree-six Weil numerators. Multinomial expansion of F^12 independently produces Hasse-Witt diagonal (0,h,0) with h nonzero, hence a-number 2 and stable p-rank 1.

evidence: The 2021 work proves unique geometric deficient a-number at p=13, but gives no F13 point counts for these forms.
The 2023 preprint proves all curves with full automorphism C6 have sextic twists, which exactly explains why there are six forms, not why there are three distinct zeta functions.
Meagher–Top 2010 illustrate twist trace methods using genus-three curves with at least sixteen automorphisms, whereas this curve has six.

value.rationale: This exhaustively classifies the exact Frobenius polynomials of all arithmetic forms of the unique exceptional order-six genus-three curve at the first relevant prime 13. The collapse of six mutually nonisomorphic forms to three zeta types and their Prym-type distinction is an intrinsic arithmetic phenomenon not implied by previously known geometric rank or twist theory; full numerical polynomials give rational-point counts over every finite extension.
